requirements.text: Proposers must hold a current Texas Professional Engineer licence for the engineer of record.
Proposers must be registered as a vendor in the City's electronic procurement system before submitting.
Proposers must document a good-faith effort toward the 15 percent minority and woman-owned business participation goal.
Proposers must carry professional liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 per claim.
4.1 The consultant shall prepare hydrologic and hydraulic models for 14 watersheds using the City's adopted methodology.
4.2 The consultant shall deliver 30 percent, 60 percent and 90 percent design submittals for each project.
4.3 The consultant must attend monthly progress meetings at the Watershed Protection offices.
4.4 The consultant shall provide construction phase services including submittal review and site visits.
4.5 The consultant should identify opportunities for green stormwater infrastructure in each design.
Proposals shall not exceed 25 pages, excluding required forms and resumes.
Submit one PDF file named VendorName-COA-IFB-2026-0447.pdf; paper copies will not be accepted.
Proposals must be uploaded to the City's electronic bidding portal before 2:00 PM Central Time on 28 October 2026.
Proposers shall complete the non-discrimination certification and the conflict-of-interest questionnaire.
Proposals will be scored on experience 30 points, project approach 30 points, team qualifications 25 points and cost 15 points.
The evaluation committee may shortlist proposers for interviews before making a recommendation.
